scope: Offline inventory of committed registries, source relationships, and published evidence. Not live operations. Counts total and state totals are catalogue rows, including evidence/relationships; distinctUrls counts sanitized URLs; distinctHosts counts lowercase hostnames without leading www or a trailing DNS dot. Neither distinct count measures publishers. Target cadence is policy, not proof of an active schedule. Unknown clocks remain unknown; contentAt is publication/change time, not event date. Held overrides failure. Link discovery is not successful collection. Source-onboarding rows are disabled review candidates/manual holds, not ingested content or operational source admissions. Freshness is evaluated at the latest recorded evidence clock; the admin view also evaluates age at viewing time.
